title: OSVVM functional coverage YAML file, format version 0.1
description: The functional coverage file '<testcase>_cov.yml' OSVVM's CoveragePkg writes ('WriteCovYaml'), format version 0.1 (OSVVM 2026.01 and later; the constant 'COVERAGE_YAML_VERSION'). Derived from the writer 'osvvm/CoveragePkg.vhd' and the reader 'Scripts/ReportCov2Html.tcl'. The writer added no key while writing version 0.1, so every key is required.

Coverage.description: The testcase's coverage in percent: the models' hits counted toward their goals, weighted by the models' weights.

WritePassFail.description: 1, if the HTML report states pass or fail per bin ('WritePassFail' or 'ErrorIfNotCovered' set).

Models.description: The coverage models with bins; the models of weight 0 last.

Flag.description: A boolean, as VHDL's 'to_upper(to_string(boolean))' writes it.

Model.description: A coverage model: its name, testcases, coverage, settings, bin information and bins.

TestCases.description: The testcases, which sampled the model.

Coverage.description: The model's coverage in percent, relative to its goal.

ModelSettings.description: The settings of a coverage model.

CovWeight.description: Weight of the model in the testcase's coverage; below 1 excludes it.

Goal.description: Coverage goal in percent ('CovTarget'), scaling the at-least counts.

Seeds.description: The two seeds of the model's randomization.

Threshold.description: Threshold in percent of intelligent coverage.

TotalCovCount.description: The hits counted toward the scaled at-least counts.

TotalCovGoal.description: The sum of the scaled at-least counts.

BinInfo.description: The model's dimensions, field names and number of bins.

Bin.description: A bin: name, type, one range per dimension, count, at-least count and percentage of coverage.

Name.description: Name of the bin; empty, if unnamed.

Count.description: How often the bin was hit.

AtLeast.description: How often the bin must be hit to be covered.

PercentCov.description: The count in percent of the at-least count.

Range.description: A range of values, both bounds included.
